arn.text: El-Hajjaj, a wizard, is found in his workshop at the castle by Taysir and Raghib after they dispel an illusionary lake over it and fight Brass Men and a Guardian Beast. Nailah, his daughter, had tried to force the Unification of Taysir, and El-Hajjaj tried to stop her and was seemingly killed, but he revealed he was still alive and aided Raghib and the white Taysir against her.

Raghib reveals that Nailah compelled him to help betray her father, and the Dervish opens the City in a Bottle and, urged by El-Hajjaj, sacrifices the Baby Taysir within. In the end Nailah kills El-Hajjaj and Raghib, and the Dervish blasts her and merges with the Apprentice, becoming the complete Taysir.
